target_forcefield: CHARMM36 additive plus compatible CGenFF terms

fixed_geometry_hessian.geometry: stereochemistry-preserving off-equilibrium conformer accepted by the registered evidence policy

rules.water_interaction_charge_scaling: Scale neutral interaction energies only; do not scale charged compounds.
rules.water_interaction_scf: Use density-fitted HF for production distance curves only after representative, identical-geometry comparisons against DIRECT HF pass the declared tolerance; do not use disk-integral PK for these model compounds.
rules.electrostatic_potential: Use a deterministic multi-shell Bondi-radius grid with points buried inside another atom removed; retain the grid and raw atomic-unit potentials for the charge objective. Record the molecular dipole from the same wavefunction for an independent whole-molecule charge-fit observable.
rules.fixed_geometry_hessian: The input geometry must come from a hash-pinned coupled-conformer plan accepted by the registered evidence policy. Preserve atom order and stereochemistry; never optimize, reflect, or silently replace the geometry. Record both the analytic gradient and the full Cartesian Hessian.
rules.release_effect: Generated or completed QM jobs do not pass a registry gate until parsed results and validation reports are attached and reviewed.

references.authority: ESP as a charge-optimization objective component
electrostatic-potential grid API, molecular properties, and units
